scope: Local native lifecycle correction and opt-in diagnostic tooling; installed correction not yet qualified.
cause: After a valid shutdown response, the ordinary Unix Stop waited for every discovered generation, including a later generation started by a live caller after owner-lock release.
correction: Capture signed generation/PID/start identities before requesting shutdown, then use existing identity-bound containment for only that set. Preserve retire-clients and non-Unix wait behavior. Clear restart budget under startup lock only when no generation remains.

tooling.scope: Only matching Stop helper subprocesses receive diagnostic logging; no resident/SDK setting changes. Preserve helper arguments, timeouts, results and exception identity.
tooling.retention: Four finite client phase labels, finite error codes, numeric timing and aggregate process transitions only; no raw stderr, tokens or PID/start identities are saved.
tooling.stop_error_parser: Match native_resident_stop_ prefix so preceding phase/note lines cannot suppress an actual Stop error.

native_regression.name: managed_resident::stop_snapshot::tests::stop_leaves_a_later_signed_generation_alive
native_regression.method: Real owned native child processes publish their own valid signed generation state. The stopped generation is killed/reaped and retired before a later signed generation appears; the earlier wait must finish without killing the later process. A subsequent explicit capture must still contain that process. Fixture cleanup kills/reaps only its own children.
native_regression.boundary: Regression isolates post-acknowledgment containment; it is not a transport, installed, performance or non-Unix qualification.
